props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// ONI Custom Event Helper (emit) – minimal inline version

// Makes ONI.emit(eventName, payload) available if it isn't already.

// ============================================================================

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

// Default: LOCAL ONLY (perfect for UI-ish things like animationStart/End)

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

// When you REALLY want to broadcast something across all clients

ONI.emitWorld = function (eventName, payload = {}) {

Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

if (!ONI._worldRx) {

ONI._worldRx = (data) => {

if (!data?.action) return;

Hooks.callAll(data.action, data.payload);

};

game.socket.on("world", ONI._worldRx);

}

console.log("[ONI Events] Helper installed.");

}

/**

* [ONI][SeqKickMotion] – Wired for ONI events + Foundry targeting

* Emits:

* - oni:animationStart (LOCAL ONLY)

* - oni:animationEnd (LOCAL ONLY)

*

* Attacker/Target resolution priority:

* 1) __PAYLOAD.attacker_uuid / __PAYLOAD.target_uuid (if provided by your system)

* 2) Controlled token + Foundry V12 targeting

*/

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][SeqKickMotion]";

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Requirements

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active || typeof Sequence === "undefined") {

return ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Resolve Attacker / Target (supports __PAYLOAD wiring)

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

let attackerToken = null;

let targetToken = null;

// 1) Payload UUIDs (system wiring)

try {

if (P.attacker_uuid) attackerToken = await fromUuid(P.attacker_uuid);

if (P.target_uuid) targetToken = await fromUuid(P.target_uuid);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(`${TAG} fromUuid payload resolve failed`, e);

}

// If fromUuid returns TokenDocument, grab object; if it's an Actor, etc, ignore

attackerToken = attackerToken?.object ?? attackerToken;

targetToken = targetToken?.object ?? targetToken;

// 2) Fallback to selection / Foundry targets

attackerToken = attackerToken ?? canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

targetToken = targetToken ?? Array.from(game.user.targets ?? [])[0] ?? null;

if (!attackerToken) return ui.notifications.warn("Select a token first.");

if (!targetToken) return ui.notifications.warn("Target a token first (use Foundry's targeting system).");

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// DEBUG: macro start

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

console.log(

`${TAG} START`,

"attacker:", attackerToken.name, `(${attackerToken.id})`,

"target:", targetToken.name, `(${targetToken.id})`,

"time:", new Date().toISOString(),

"payload:", P

);

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Broadcast: Animation START (LOCAL ONLY)

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const animMeta = {

type: "kickTeleport",

sourceTokenId: attackerToken.id,

targetTokenId: targetToken.id,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

};

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", animMeta, { local: true, world: false });

// -----------------------------

// Tuners (YOUR CURRENT VALUES)

// -----------------------------

const FADE_OUT_MS = 700;

const GAP_AFTER_FADE_MS = 500;

const FADE_IN_MS = 700;

const DRAMATIC_PAUSE_MS = 350;

const RUN_BACK_MIN_MS = 350;

const RUN_BACK_MAX_MS = 1400;

const RUN_PIXELS_PER_SEC = 1400;

const POST_RUN_BACK_PAUSE_MS = 80;

const PRE_KICK_PAUSE_MS = 140;

const JUMP_TO_TARGET_MS = 180;

// Pause at the kick position before returning

const POST_KICK_PAUSE_MS = 220;

const RETURN_MS = 320;

const FRONT_OF_TARGET_GRIDS = 0.75;

const KICK_OFFSET_GRIDS = 0.25;

const EASE_RUN = "easeInOutCubic";

const EASE_JUMP = "easeOutQuad";

const EASE_RETURN = "easeInOutQuad";

// -----------------------------

// Screen Flash Tuners

// -----------------------------

const FLASH_IMG = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/whiteSquare.png";

const FLASH_SCALE = 50;

const FLASH_OPACITY = 0.6;

const FLASH_FADE_MS = 500;

const FLASH_ZINDEX = 9999;

// -----------------------------

// Sound Tuners

// -----------------------------

const SOUND_BROADCAST = true; // everyone hears

const FOOTSTEP_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_FootStepNormal_1.ogg";

const WIND_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind3.ogg";

const KICK_SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage1.ogg";

const FOOTSTEP_VOL = 0.75;

const WIND_VOL = 0.8;

const KICK_VOL = 0.9;

// “Throttle” rate for footsteps during ground movement only

const FOOTSTEP_INTERVAL_MS = 300;

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Helpers

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

const playSfx = (src, volume = 0.8) => {

AudioHelper.play({ src, volume, autoplay: true, loop: false }, SOUND_BROADCAST);

};

// Footsteps: start/stop looped “throttle”

let footstepTimer = null;

const startFootsteps = () => {

if (footstepTimer) return;

playSfx(FOOTSTEP_SFX, FOOTSTEP_VOL);

footstepTimer = setInterval(() => playSfx(FOOTSTEP_SFX, FOOTSTEP_VOL), FOOTSTEP_INTERVAL_MS);

};

const stopFootsteps = () => {

if (!footstepTimer) return;

clearInterval(footstepTimer);

footstepTimer = null;

};

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Compute positions

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const originDoc = {

x: attackerToken.document.x,

y: attackerToken.document.y,

alpha: attackerToken.document.alpha ?? 1

};

const originCenter = {

x: originDoc.x + attackerToken.w / 2,

y: originDoc.y + attackerToken.h / 2

};

const targetCenter = { x: targetToken.center.x, y: targetToken.center.y };

const gridSize = canvas.grid?.size ?? 100;

const dx = targetCenter.x - originCenter.x;

const dy = targetCenter.y - originCenter.y;

const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;

const ux = dx / dist;

const uy = dy / dist;

const frontDist = Math.max(gridSize * FRONT_OF_TARGET_GRIDS, gridSize * 0.1);

const frontPos = {

x: targetCenter.x - ux * frontDist,

y: targetCenter.y - uy * frontDist

};

const kickDist = Math.max(gridSize * KICK_OFFSET_GRIDS, gridSize * 0.05);

const kickPos = {

x: targetCenter.x - ux * kickDist,

y: targetCenter.y - uy * kickDist

};

const runBackDistance = Math.hypot(frontPos.x - originCenter.x, frontPos.y - originCenter.y);

const runBackMsRaw = (runBackDistance / RUN_PIXELS_PER_SEC) * 1000;

const runBackMs = Math.round(Math.max(RUN_BACK_MIN_MS, Math.min(RUN_BACK_MAX_MS, runBackMsRaw)));

const screenCenter = { x: window.innerWidth / 2, y: window.innerHeight / 2 };

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Play animation (phased for clean footstep control)

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

try {

// Phase 1: Fade out + teleport + fade in (+ wind)

playSfx(WIND_SFX, WIND_VOL);

await new Sequence()

.animation()

.on(attackerToken)

.fadeOut(FADE_OUT_MS)

.opacity(0)

.waitUntilFinished()

.wait(GAP_AFTER_FADE_MS)

.animation()

.on(attackerToken)

.teleportTo(frontPos, { relativeToCenter: true })

.waitUntilFinished()

.animation()

.on(attackerToken)

.fadeIn(FADE_IN_MS)

.opacity(originDoc.alpha)

.waitUntilFinished()

.wait(DRAMATIC_PAUSE_MS)

.play();

// Phase 2: Run back (footsteps ON)

startFootsteps();

await new Sequence()

.animation()

.on(attackerToken)

.moveTowards(originCenter, { relativeToCenter: true, ease: EASE_RUN, rotate: false })

.duration(runBackMs)

.waitUntilFinished()

.play();

stopFootsteps();

await waitMs(POST_RUN_BACK_PAUSE_MS);

// Ensure EXACT home position

await new Sequence()

.animation()

.on(attackerToken)

.teleportTo(originCenter, { relativeToCenter: true })

.waitUntilFinished()

.play();

// Tiny pause before kick rush

await waitMs(PRE_KICK_PAUSE_MS);

// Phase 3: Jump kick (NO footsteps)

await new Sequence()

.animation()

.on(attackerToken)

.moveTowards(kickPos, { relativeToCenter: true, ease: EASE_JUMP, rotate: false })

.duration(JUMP_TO_TARGET_MS)

.waitUntilFinished()

// Impact flash (kick connects)

.effect(FLASH_IMG)

.atLocation(screenCenter)

.screenSpaceAboveUI()

.zIndex(FLASH_ZINDEX)

.scale(FLASH_SCALE)

.opacity(FLASH_OPACITY)

.fadeOut(FLASH_FADE_MS)

.play();

// Impact SFX (kick connects)

playSfx(KICK_SFX, KICK_VOL);

// Post-kick pause

await waitMs(POST_KICK_PAUSE_MS);

// Phase 4: Return (footsteps ON)

startFootsteps();

await new Sequence()

.animation()

.on(attackerToken)

.moveTowards(originCenter, { relativeToCenter: true, ease: EASE_RETURN, rotate: false })

.duration(RETURN_MS)

.waitUntilFinished()

.play();

stopFootsteps();

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} ERROR`, err);

ui.notifications.error(`${TAG} Error - check console (F12).`);

} finally {

// Ensure footsteps never get stuck

stopFootsteps();

// Hard restore safety

try {

await attackerToken.document.update({

x: originDoc.x,

y: originDoc.y,

alpha: originDoc.alpha

});

} catch (_) {}

// Broadcast: Animation END (LOCAL ONLY)

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

...animMeta,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// DEBUG: macro end

console.log(

`${TAG} END`,

"attacker:", attackerToken.name,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

}

})();
